_doc: HEALBOT for Gravewyrm Sanctum: ryze3/ryzeheal (priest) auto-follows + heals a leader you control yourself (log into ryze4/ryzetank in a real browser, pull one mob at a time, fight the bosses; this keeps you alive). Invite ryzeheal to your party and it follows, heals (dying -> you -> most-hurt), assists with wand, and follows you THROUGH the Sanctum door into the instance. One socket, one character (not a multibox). Run: node scripts/companion.mjs scripts/companion.gravewyrm.json
